content.text: {"comps":[{"label":"C1","good":false,"reason":"Microturbine power generation systems, not process heating, heat tracing or heating controls; different equipment and end use."},{"label":"C2","good":false,"reason":"Diversified aerospace components, valves, pumps and composite panels; no heat tracing or process heating overlap."},{"label":"C3","good":false,"reason":"Welding and cutting consumables and equipment; a different industrial product category despite shared plant customers."},{"label":"C4","good":false,"reason":"Utility smart meters, filtration and defense electronics; does not make heating products or heat tracing systems."},{"label":"C5","good":false,"reason":"Pumps, valves and mechanical seals sold to the same plant customers, but rotating and flow control equipment rather than heating systems."},{"label":"C6","good":false,"reason":"Pumps, valves, brake friction products and connectors; different products despite some overlapping process plant customers."},{"label":"C7","good":false,"reason":"Papermaking and wood processing equipment; serves paper mills rather than process heating plant operators."},{"label":"C8","good":false,"reason":"Personal safety gear and gas detectors sold to industrial employers; no heating products or heating system services."},{"label":"C9","good":true,"reason":"Pre-insulated heating and piping systems sold project-style to contractors and oil and gas operators, with engineering and installation services."},{"label":"C10","good":false,"reason":"Switchgear, substations and motor control centers for electrical power distribution; different products despite petrochemical customers."},{"label":"C11","good":false,"reason":"HVAC equipment, UV disinfection and detection instruments for buildings and utilities; not industrial process heating."},{"label":"C12","good":false,"reason":"Pumps only, sold for water, fire protection and petroleum; no heating products or heat tracing business."}]}
